details.description: Grok 4.20 (non-reasoning) is xAI's fast, non-reasoning-mode variant of its Grok 4.20 release, documented with a 1,000,000-token context window. xAI's docs describe it as a high-performance model with industry-leading speed and agentic tool-calling capabilities, plus a low hallucination rate and strict prompt adherence. It takes text and image input and produces text output. This catalog id is one of several aliases xAI's own docs list for the model, all resolving to the dated checkpoint grok-4.20-0309-non-reasoning, whose system card is dated April 7, 2026. Artificial Analysis's current benchmarking marks this snapshot deprecated in favor of xAI's newer Grok 4.3 (Non-reasoning).
advantages: xAI describes it as a high-performance model with industry-leading speed and agentic tool-calling capabilities, per xAI's docs.
xAI states the model has a low hallucination rate with strict adherence to prompts, per xAI's docs.
Artificial Analysis reports an output speed of 93.3 tokens/second, above the median for comparable models.
Artificial Analysis reports a time to first token of 0.63 seconds.
disadvantages: Runs with reasoning disabled, so it does not perform the extended step-by-step reasoning of the reasoning variant of Grok 4.20.
Not designed or intended for high-risk applications such as autonomous medical, legal, financial or safety-critical decisions without human oversight, per xAI's Grok 4.20 system card.
Artificial Analysis scores it 14 on its Intelligence Index, below the reported peer median, and marks the snapshot deprecated in favor of Grok 4.3 (Non-reasoning).
use_cases: Fast general-purpose assistant tasks: question answering, writing and everyday requests
Agentic tool-calling workflows where low latency matters
Coding and translation tasks that do not require extended reasoning
Multimodal tasks combining text and image input

notes: The catalog id 'grok-4.20-experimental-beta-non-reasoning-latest' is one of several aliases xAI's docs explicitly list for the model id grok-4.20-0309-non-reasoning (confirmed on docs.x.ai/developers/models/grok-4.20-0309-non-reasoning, which names this exact alias string). Artificial Analysis states a 2.0M-token context window for this snapshot, which conflicts with the catalog's 1,000,000; the catalog figure was kept per instructions. xAI's system card names supported languages only as examples (English, Chinese, Arabic, Hindi, Spanish, 'and several dozen others with varying levels of capability') without a closed list, so languages is left empty. xAI's own current models page still lists the model with no deprecation flag and the catalog carries no deprecation_date; only Artificial Analysis (third-party) marks this snapshot deprecated, in favor of Grok 4.3 (Non-reasoning).
